title: rest/spec: a public form's title has no translation key, and GET /forms/:slug serves it untranslated, so a localized form can only be titled in one language
body:
Filing gate **① a measured defect**, found by a `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 dispatch for objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2060 (item 14; report on that card, PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2212). Measured on HotCRM `main` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`, console objectui `616df6598b42`). Filed by the seat (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it. HotCRM authors no title while it waits: an English title would replace today's translated heading for every non-English visitor (measured below).

## The finding, as measured

- **Context:** HotCRM's public forms `web_to_lead` (slug `contact-us`) and `web_to_case` (slug `support`) declare no `title`, so a visitor's heading is the object label ("Lead", "Case"), translated.
- **Probe** (local, uncommitted, reverted): declaring `title` on `web_to_lead`, plus a zh-CN pack key for it.
  - `GET /api/v1/forms/contact-us` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN` answered `form.title` in English.
  - The console's public form `/_console/f/contact-us` showed that English title above zh-CN and ja-JP section headings.
- **So:** an app cannot give a public form a title that is localized. Declaring one regresses every non-authoring locale from a translated heading to an untranslated one.
- **Reach:** every public form (Web-to-Lead, Web-to-Case and the like) that wants a real title, in every non-authoring locale.

## Seat review (from the dev's reading at 18.0.0)

- **spec:** `FormViewSchema.title` is a plain string with no translation key. The `_views` schema aliases `title` to `label`.
- **rest:** `registerFormEndpoints` translates the view, then answers `label` from `match.view` before translation, and serves `config.title` untranslated. `translateView` never reads `config.title`.
- **console** (objectui `apps/console` `FormPage` `loadPublicForm`): the heading is `payload.label ?? form.title ?? objectSchema.label`. objectstack-ai/objectui#8814 made it render the authored title, as declared.
- **Candidate shape, for triage:** a translation key for a form view's title (for example under `objects.<object>._views.<view>.title`), applied by `translateView` and served translated by `/forms/:slug`.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title (every state, #1–#24970) and every objectstack-ai/objectui issue title (#7–#13280), listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint (refreshed with `since=2026-10-20T17:00Z`) and matched case-insensitively. The search API is refused for this session.
- Related, closed: #23497 (`GET /forms/:slug` returned the form's section labels untranslated; fixed for sections only); #23632 (no exported resolver localized a form view's sections); objectstack-ai/objectui#8814 (render the authored title); objectstack-ai/objectui#8813 / #8836 (translate the public form's section headings).
- **New:** the title is the remaining untranslatable string on this door.
